dataset: US Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI-U), U.S. city average, all items, not seasonally adjusted — BLS series CUUR0000SA0
publisher: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), U.S. Department of Labor
jurisdiction: United States (U.S. city average; all urban consumers, about 90% of the population)
licence: Public domain — "The Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) is a Federal government agency and everything that we publish, both in hard copy and electronically, is in the public domain, except for previously copyrighted photographs and illustrations. You are free to use our public domain material without specific permission, although we do ask that you cite the Bureau of Labor Statistics as the source." (https://www.bls.gov/bls/linksite.htm, Copyright Information)
attribution: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Consumer Price Index, series CUUR0000SA0.
fetchedVia: https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/ (POST, series CUUR0000SA0), https://www.bls.gov/bls/news-release/cpi.htm and the two newest archived releases, https://www.bls.gov/schedule/news_release/cpi.htm
verificationMethod: The BLS Public Data API v2 (https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/, series CUUR0000SA0, 2020–present with annual averages) gives every index level; the CPI release archive (https://www.bls.gov/bls/news-release/cpi.htm) gives each reference month's release day and archived release; that release's "Not seasonally adjusted CPI measures" sentence gives the 12-month change and must state the same index level as the API and the same change as the two published index values (rounded to one decimal); the next release day is read from the schedule (https://www.bls.gov/schedule/news_release/cpi.htm). Values are copied as published, never estimated.
